description: This file defines the TestCluster class used for local testing of Orleans silos, including methods for starting, stopping, and managing silos and clients within a test environment.

classes.name: TestCluster
classes.description: A class for managing a local Orleans test cluster with in-process silos, providing methods for deployment, management, and cleanup of silos and clients during testing.

methods.name: Deploy
methods.description: Synchronously deploys the test cluster with initial silos and client.

methods.name: DeployAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deploys the test cluster with initial silos and client.

methods.name: StartSiloAsync
methods.description: Starts a new silo asynchronously in the cluster.

methods.name: StartAdditionalSilo
methods.description: Starts an additional silo synchronously.

methods.name: StartAdditionalSiloAsync
methods.description: Starts a single additional silo asynchronously.

methods.name: StartAdditionalSilosAsync
methods.description: Starts multiple additional silos asynchronously.

methods.name: StopSecondarySilosAsync
methods.description: Stops all secondary silos asynchronously.

methods.name: StopPrimarySiloAsync
methods.description: Stops the primary silo asynchronously.

methods.name: StopClusterClientAsync
methods.description: Stops the cluster client asynchronously.

methods.name: StopAllSilos
methods.description: Stops all silos synchronously.

methods.name: StopAllSilosAsync
methods.description: Stops all silos asynchronously.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync
methods.description: Stops a specific silo asynchronously.

methods.name: KillSiloAsync
methods.description: Kills a specific silo asynchronously to simulate a crash.

methods.name: KillClientAsync
methods.description: Performs a hard kill on the client asynchronously.

methods.name: RestartSiloAsync
methods.description: Restarts a specific silo asynchronously.

methods.name: RestartStoppedSecondarySiloAsync
methods.description: Restarts a previously stopped secondary silo asynchronously.

methods.name: InitializeClientAsync
methods.description: Initializes the cluster client asynchronously.

methods.name: GetSiloServiceProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the service provider for a specific silo or a random one if null.

methods.name: GetActiveSilos
methods.description: Returns an enumerable of active silos.

methods.name: GetSiloForAddress
methods.description: Finds the silo handle for a given silo address.

methods.name: WaitForLivenessToStabilizeAsync
methods.description: Waits for the liveness subsystem to stabilize after membership changes.

methods.name: GetLivenessStabilizationTime
methods.description: Calculates the timeout duration for liveness stabilization based on options.

methods.name: GetLog
methods.description: Returns the accumulated log string.
